content.text: No restrictive covenant exists; the agreement affirmatively disclaims exclusivity.

input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on AP. Section 1 (p0001) expressly disclaims any exclusive arrangement and confirms AP remains free to offer or sell Inventory through other agents or third parties. The only Customer-side restrictions found (p0025) are ordinary licence-use limits on the Kubient Service itself (no reverse engineering, no third-party access, no resale of the Service) and do not restrict the businesses AP may operate or the products it may buy or build; the Kubient licence at p0002 is non-exclusive and no sourcing, territory, first-look or minimum-volume commitment appears anywhere. This meets the preferred position, so no redline is proposed.
